item.name: Found Footage
item.effect: The job is dark except for Video Camera night vision, and you spawn with a free Video Camera.
item.notes: The free camera is separate from cameras you bring or buy. A 6-player party that also buys 3 cameras can carry 10 Video Cameras.
item.cardSummary: You hunt in the dark and see through Video Camera night vision. A free camera is added to your inventory for the job.

item.name: Invisible Ghost
item.effect: The ghost's physical appearances stay invisible.
item.notes: Laser Projector evidence is the documented exception. Other manifestations stay hidden.
item.cardSummary: You usually cannot see the ghost's body. Track it with tools, especially the Laser Projector, instead of watching it appear.

item.name: Blindness
item.effect: You can only see about 10 studs around you. The rest of your view is dark.
item.notes: Navigation and spotting the ghost get much harder because most of the screen is blacked out.
item.cardSummary: A short sight radius leaves you hunting almost blind, so movement and ghost tracking take extra care.

item.name: Oops, All Therms
item.effect: Every piece of equipment becomes a Thermometer, including gear that spawns on the site.
item.notes: Normal investigation tools are gone, so evidence work has to rely on thermometers and ghost behavior.
item.cardSummary: The highest payout. Your loadout and map spawns all turn into thermometers, leaving almost no standard gear.

item.name: Exploding Items
item.effect: Held equipment has a timer bar. If you are still holding it when the bar runs out, it explodes and kills you.
item.notes: Charged items such as the Salt Canister explode when fully used instead of using a bar.
item.cardSummary: Do not keep holding a tool until its bar empties. Drop or swap it first, and treat charge-based gear the same when it runs out.

item.name: Inventory Lock
item.effect: Once you pick up an item, you cannot drop it.
item.notes: Items that leave on their own still can, including Energy Drink and Umbra Board.
item.cardSummary: Plan pickups carefully. Whatever you grab stays in your inventory unless the game forces that item out.

item.name: Musical Items
item.effect: Every 30 seconds, the team's inventory swaps with random Equipment and Cursed Objects.
item.notes: Hunters cannot drop the items they are given.
item.cardSummary: Inventories change every 30 seconds to random equipment and cursed objects, and you cannot drop what you receive.

item.name: Hide & Seek
item.effect: The ghost changes its room once per minute.
item.notes: Temperature, ghost orbs, and hunt start location move with the new room.
item.cardSummary: Keep re-finding the ghost room. After each minute the favorite room, orbs, and hunt origin can shift.

item.name: Mimicry
item.effect: Every ghost fakes one extra random piece of evidence on top of its real three.
item.notes: Identify by traits, not evidence count alone. Doppelganger will not fake Ghost Orb.
item.cardSummary: A fourth fake evidence appears, so a three-evidence match can still be wrong. Use hunt behavior to confirm the ghost.
